A.unit_free: d/k^2 (k != 0); sign of d (k = 0); sign of k

verdict.k: fundamental (first generator coefficient); its size is a unit choice, only sign survives a unit change
verdict.d: fundamental (second generator coefficient); with k: d/k^2 is the unit-free number; curvature -Delta/4 is a reading
verdict.s: fundamental number (rank 3 with k, d); same operation as p, applied along an axis
verdict.p: fundamental number (rank 2 with s); it is the height across axes, p = 2^s on the Pythagorean sum
verdict.t: fundamental as an input (one per element), not a law dial: odds compose by the k = 1 law; k is absorbed into t in subset chances
verdict.r: partly derived: n ratios = D plus n-1 relative odds; only the overall zoom (equivalently D) is its own
verdict.q: partly derived: for moves built from the plane law the order turn is d x area; counts see q only as k = q - 1; new only when put in by hand (hbar is then a unit for continuous moves; on a lattice q is a real invariant)
